description: Sithu Aung is a PhD student at Czech Technical University in Prague, researching 3D vision, scene reconstruction and understanding, and digital twins.

research.title: 3D Vision
research.description: Recovering geometry, camera pose, and structure from images.

research.title: Scene Reconstruction & Understanding
research.description: Reconstructing scenes and understanding objects, people, and their spatial relationships.

research.title: Digital Twins
research.description: Exploring visual representations that connect physical environments with their digital counterparts.

paragraphs: I am a PhD student in the Visual Recognition Group at Czech Technical University in Prague, supervised by Zuzana Kúkelová and co-supervised by Torsten Sattler.

Previously, I completed my M.S. and worked as an intern researcher in the Visual Intelligence Group at the Korea Institute of Science and Technology / University of Science and Technology, Korea, under Junghyun Cho.
